Do NOT import-time-run any journey.

TASK 2, check builder. In factory/checks/library.py add `journey_reachability_check(*, budget_s: int = 240) -> str` using the file's existing helpers (`_finish`, `_checked`, `_quote`) so the output passes `lint_check`. Add tests to tests/test_factory_checks.py (extend that file; follow its style): the script contains the --run-nightly flag, `date +%s` and no `SECONDS`; it passes `lint_check`; `budget_s` appears in the generated text; a tiny fake-pytest harness (a temp directory whose `.venv/bin/python` is a shell stub that exits 0 or 1, if the file already uses `probe_unsatisfiable` or similar helpers follow that) shows exit code 0 on success and non-zero with the reason printed on failure. Keep these tests under 5 seconds and never run the real journeys.

Register the new test file: run `.venv/bin/python scripts/regen_shard_durations.py --missing-only` and keep only the one new entry. Wiring the check into a factory station is NOT part of this task; say in NOTES.txt where it would plug in (station 5 free gates) and what you found.
